::: {.lead}
IMF Monitor makes research data on the International Monetary Fund accessible to academics, policymakers, journalists, and civil society. The data are compiled by independent researchers, not published by the IMF. They draw on IMF documents and aim to let users trace results back to their documentary sources.
:::
